focus.description: Free text about what to put first, such as `error tracking` or `billing reports`. A request with focus always starts a new build, and an unfocused request never reuses it. Pass `wait_seconds` to wait for it.

limit.description: The most reports to return, best first. Defaults to 25. Values above the configured maximum (50) use the maximum.

max_age_minutes.description: The oldest `checked_at` you accept. When the stored list is older, the request reads every candidate report, which can take some seconds, and starts a build if your inbox changed. Leave it out to get the stored list quickly. A new report then joins the list at the next scheduled build.

refresh.description: Start a new build even when the stored one is current. The build runs in the background, so the response has `building: true`. Pass `wait_seconds` to wait for it.

wait_seconds.description: When the request starts a build or one is running, wait for its list until this many seconds after the request started. Defaults to 0, which does not wait. A build usually takes 10 to 60 seconds.
